name: Default
shortDescription: mStream personal music streaming server with a web player, playlists, transcoding and an admin panel, keeping its config, database and music library on persistent volumes.

alerts.message: mStream starts in public mode with no login: anyone with the URL can use the player and the admin panel at /admin until a user exists. Create an admin user in the admin panel right after the first deploy.
The music library starts empty and file uploading is disabled by default. Enable it under Admin > Settings > File Uploading to add music through the web player.
